reviews.text: great staff! Very nice and attentive to all our needs.

I am incredibly grateful to the entire team at Brighter Veterinary Center. My cat developed a serious open wound after repeatedly licking her very swollen elbow, and from the moment I contacted the clinic, I felt that she was in caring hands.

The ladies at the front desk were wonderful—kind, compassionate, thorough, and understanding of how worried I was. They recognized that my kitty needed to be seen quickly and were able to schedule her immediately.

Dr. Ock was incredibly thorough. He took his time examining her and really dug deeper to understand the underlying cause of the swelling and wound rather than simply treating what was visible on the surface. He carefully explained his findings, the different treatment options, and, most importantly, the reasoning behind his recommendations. I never felt rushed, and my questions and concerns were taken seriously.

I was especially grateful for how gently everyone handled my precious kitty. The wonderful ladies assisting with her care were patient and caring while sedating and preparing her for treatment. When your pet is frightened and hurting, seeing people handle her with genuine tenderness means more than I can express.

Dr. Ock performed a debridement to clean the wound and remove unhealthy tissue. For the past four days, they have been carefully tending to the wound and giving it a chance to improve before attempting surgical closure. Today, we are hopeful that it will finally be ready to close.

This has been an extremely stressful experience for us, but the compassion, patience, thoroughness, and communication we have received from Dr. Ock and the entire Brighter Veterinary Center team have made a tremendous difference. I am deeply thankful for the care they have given my kitty and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly takes the time to investigate, explain, and care for their patient.
Dr. Ock was very informative and created a detailed treatment plan for my cat. Everyone was super professional. Thank you!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5!

I’m very happy with my experience at Brighter Veterinary Center in Northridge. I brought my adult Siberian Husky here and was very pleased with how caring, attentive, and professional everyone was.

I’m very happy to have found a veterinary clinic I can trust with my pets. I’m planning to bring my cat here as well.

Thank you, Brighter Veterinary Center, for taking such good care of my Husky! 🐾❤️ I would definitely recommend this clinic to other dog and cat owners in Northridge and the surrounding areas.

They helped us keep her comfortable until it was time to say good bye. It was a very compassionate experience and we would definitely go back.

The vet seems like he do doesn't even like animals. All business to him. At least pretend you do. Take some interest in the animals.  That said, the place is very new and very clean. It is a bit pricey. Yes, I know things can't function for free. But it's on the pricier site.

I just want to acknowledge my experience with Brighter Veterinary Center and their staff. If I hadn't been in such a dog mom panic, I would have caught her name but whomever you are, thank you. Thank you for getting back to me so quickly, for listening to me and for you and your staff sorting out how to get my emergency for my sweet girl, taken care of, immediately. Highly recommend, great team and outstanding service. They truly care, they didn’t even charge at times for follow ups, they made sure my dog was ok.

I had a very disappointing experience from the moment I arrived. It felt like the focus was more on money than on the care of my dog. While my dog was in labor, I asked the doctor to explain why certain procedures were necessary. Although I agreed to most of them, I simply wanted clarification on one.

Instead of providing an explanation, the doctor became upset and told me that if I didn’t like his services, I should leave immediately. This was extremely concerning, especially given the urgent condition my dog was in at the time. I was fully prepared to proceed with treatment and pay a significant amount, but was dismissed instead.

To make matters worse, one of the puppies was born during this interaction, and there was a noticeable lack of compassion and urgency from the doctor. As a pet owner, that was very difficult to witness.

Overall, this experience felt unprofessional and lacked the level of care and empathy I would expect when trusting someone with the health and safety of my pet.
Great service, super clean office!

The costumer service was amazing they made me feel at home, I'm a first time dog mom my husband deliverers here and he asked questions are they were so welcoming.

Thank you everyone for the amazing service. We look forward to coming back

Amazing staff & vets! We’ve been coming here for about a year & they’ve been amazing with our pets. Thank you for all you do for our community!

Brought my dog in recently for an exam and imaging. The staff was friendly and the process was overall smooth. The doctor took time to explain findings and next steps, which I appreciated.

The clinic itself was clean and didn’t have that strong vet smell, which I think helped a lot because my dog wasn’t even scared during the visit.

Pricing was discussed upfront and they were able to fit us in quickly, which helped given the situation. My dog was handled with care throughout.

Overall, a good experience and I’d consider coming back depending on future needs.

I left the hospital shocked and speechless after my visit. I waited about 45 minutes, and when the doctor Ock finally came in, he quickly started listing many tests and concerns without properly explaining anything. As a first-time puppy owner, this was overwhelming and confusing.

When I tried to ask questions, he seemed irritated and unwilling to answer. When he asked if I agreed to all the tests, I explained that I didn’t fully understand and preferred to start with just the first vaccine. At that point, he became visibly frustrated, stood up, closed the door, and said a nurse would come speak to me—without any proper explanation or even a goodbye.

I left with many unanswered questions and felt dismissed and uncomfortable. This was a very disappointing experience, especially for a first visit with my puppy.

Just over a year ago, we adopted/rescued a cat and, due to the proximity to my home and availability of appointments, I brought her to this vet even though I had been taking my other cat to another vet for 3 years already.  I must say, a year later and plus one more kitty since then, I'm quite happy with the level of service I receive every time we come in.  Dr. Ock is extremely informative and kind when it comes to my cats.  He likes to ensure I have the pertinent information and then some.  I greatly appreciate this in a vet, or any service provider for that matter.  I never feel like I'm doing something wrong as he and his staff just like to be informative, supportive and educational.  I also don't feel dumb for asking questions.  Everyone is very compassionate in that office.  Costs are comparable, and sometimes lower, than other vets in the area.  I even switched my older cat to this vet instead of the one I took her to for 4 years now.

Our experiences at Brighter Veterinary Center have been exceptional! Dr. Ock and his staff are fantastic! They are truly concerned for the well-being of the pets they treat. Given the time sensitive nature of the issue, Dr. Ock and his staff were gracious enough to stay well past the clinic closing time to help our fur baby. They even called me a week later to check in. We've had other visits too, and each time we've had a positive experience. 10/10 recommend!

Dr. Ock quickly guessed it might be something in my dog’s belly, found a spleen mass with X-ray and ultrasound, and did the urgent surgery that same day. Now my dog is doing great and back to his normal self.

Fast, accurate, and truly caring service from a vet you can trust. Highly recommend!

I also love that they provide texting in addition to phone calls as I feel they're extremely easy and clear to communicate with. I can't recommend this place more if you're looking for a great vet to come to regularly.

They only care about getting you to spend money. They lure you in with cheap intial exams to try and get you buy expensive tests for your animal.

I brought my cat in for examination for some concerning symtoms. They had me wait for half an hour after checking in for my appointment and getting history and temp. Then the doctor came in listened to her breathing for 30 seconds and immediatly tried to force me to get a 300$ xray and an additonal 400$ virus test. Didn't tell me any concerns or issues I should be aware of. When I told him I was concerned about the price and wether or not an xray was even necessary. He raised his voice and tried to force me to get one anyway. Consantly interupting me and not letting me speak. He also tried to give me some excuse that the radioligist examination was another 200 dollars that the vet was covering. Go somewhere else. Pretty sure these 5 star reviews are fake.

This clinic is a complete disgrace. The veterinarian showed zero real care for our dog — just pushed a bunch of overpriced, unnecessary medications that did absolutely nothing. We came in multiple times, and every single time, instead of actually diagnosing the issue, they tried to upsell us on ridiculous procedures costing over $1,000.

Our dog didn’t even appear that sick, so thankfully we trusted our gut and went to a different vet for a second opinion. There, they ran proper tests, identified a simple infection, and prescribed basic antibiotics. Two weeks later, our dog was totally fine.

This place is not about helping animals — it’s about draining your wallet. Avoid this clinic at all costs if you value your pet’s health. They care more about profit than your pet’s life.

Again, thank you to you and your staff for being loving as much as the world needs it & our fur babies!
Dr. Ock was so knowledgeable and kind.  He made sure our family had all information needed to care for our dog.
